messages:
maria: Heads up — running long-context chat_suite and seeing steady memory growth tied to KV cache. After ~10k tokens memory doesn't drop between sessions, e.g. nightly-run heap profile attached. :eyes:

jon: Can you repro locally or is this only on CI?

maria: Repros locally with small harness. I added repro harness under runtime/tests/long_context_reuse.py. Steps: create two distinct requests with ~4096 tokens each, repeated 50x. Memory increases ~30MB per iteration.

kevin: Thoughts — could be page reuse touching stale reference counts or wrong token alignment when we splice pages. Any logs from eviction?

maria: Eviction logs show pages marked evicted but offsets still referenced. Snippet: ```
[KV] evict page_id=42 flags=0x1 prev_offset=8192 page_version=7
... later we see: [KV] serve page_id=42 offset=8192 tag=0x3
```

sophie: Did we recently change page packing? I remember a patch that tightened alignment for compressed blocks (commit 9f3c2b). Might have missed clearing per-request metadata.

jon: I ran ASAN build and got a handful of stale reads in kv_page_manager::get_block(). Stack shows reuse of page buffer after eviction call returns.

kevin: I think the core is token alignment + cross-request reuse. When we compute block index we do: ```idx = (token_pos - page_start) >> LOG_SHIFT;``` but if token_pos is relative to a different anchor (we used global_pos somewhere) you can land in wrong block and reuse prior live block.

maria: Filed issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/2145 — summary: KV pages sometimes mapped with stale tag leading to cross-request contamination. Repro harness attached.

perf-bot: nightly-regression: kv_cache_long_context growth +12% (long_context_suite) — alerted: eng-runtime oncall.

kevin: Quick local patch that helped: bump page_version on request boundary so an old page won't be considered fresh if tags mismatch. Ugly but reduces cross-request hits: ```
- page.version = global_version;
+ page.version = ++global_version;
```

sophie: That's a reasonable short-term mitigation. We should instead ensure alignment normalization at allocation and clear per-page last_owner bit on eviction. Add unit tests for: wrong_alignment -> assert no cross-request reads, and for repeated allocate/evict cycles.

jon: I'll add a regression test under runtime/tests/kv_eviction_regress.py and wire it into CI. Also adding an assert in the eviction slow-path to fail if refcount != 0.

maria: Looping in perf infra to run long-context suite more often. Assigned to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

kevin: Plan: (1) short-term bump page_version on request boundary, (2) add assertion and test, (3) root cause: fix index calc to use normalized token_pos, (4) candidate revert of commit 9f3c2b if needed.

sophie: Add postmortem if this hits prod. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maria: Will follow up with PRs for tests + mitigation.
